StackType.rationale: PowerStackType.Counter. The sim has no StackType concept; Power.on_stack (powers.py:64-66) adds unconditionally, which is what PowerCmd.ModifyAmount does (PowerCmd.cs:236). Third-file citations, not hashed here.

AfterCardPlayed.issue: The copy is rebuilt from the class rather than cloned. JugglingPower.cs:48 is `cardPlay.Card.CreateClone()`, which reproduces the card's full live state; powers.py:827-829 constructs `type(card)()` and replays `card.upgrade_level` upgrades onto it. Upgrade level is therefore carried and everything else is not -- a this-combat cost override (ConfusedPower/Snecko Eye, powers.py:3867-3873), an affliction (Entangled, Ringing, Smog, Bound, Galvanized, Tainted -- all ported), or a this-turn free flag would all be dropped. DORMANT only in the narrow sense that no test exercises it; the route is a Snecko-Eye or Tangled combat plus a Juggling trigger, both ported. Named trigger: any Juggling copy of a card carrying per-combat state. Third-file citations, not hashed here.

AfterSideTurnEnd.issue: SLOT. AbstractModel.AfterSideTurnEnd is dispatched by Hook.AfterTurnEnd (Hook.cs:1267-1292), called for the player side at CombatManager.cs:1307 -- AFTER the turn-end card effects and the hand flush. The sim's on_player_turn_end is Hook.BeforeTurnEnd (combat.py:654), before _process_turn_end_cards (combat.py:658) and before the flush (:661-662); the sim's real AfterTurnEnd slot, after_player_turn_end (combat.py:665), is available and unused. The concrete route for this whole group: StampedePower (powers.py:1025-1041) auto-plays Attacks from ITS on_player_turn_end, so in the game every turn-end auto-play happens while this power is still on the creature and in the sim that depends on registration order. Reproduce with `py tools/audit/power_census.py slots`. Third-file citations, not hashed here. For Juggling the consequence is concrete: the sim zeroes the attack counter BEFORE Stampede's turn-end Attack auto-plays, so those attacks count towards NEXT turn's total of three and can trigger Juggling a play early. The game resets after them.

guards.rationale: powers.py:821-822 tests CardType.ATTACK before incrementing. Identical.

powers.py:824 uses `== 3` too, not `>= 3`, so Juggling fires on the third Attack only and not on the fourth and fifth. Matching an exact-equality test rather than 'improving' it is the right call and the sim made it.

C# counts Attack CardPlaysStarted this turn belonging to the owner; powers.py:815-817 calls combat.history.attack_plays_this_turn(). The owner filter is a single-player tautology. This is the mechanism that makes a mid-turn Juggling application count the turn's earlier Attacks, and the sim has it.

powers.py:830 CardPileCmd.add_to_hand, which is the sim's generated-card path and fires on_card_entered_combat. Pile-verb semantics (MaxCardsInHand, index) belong to creature_card_cmds, not to this unit.
